name: pc_health_guardian
description: Deep local Windows/desktop health diagnosis and conservative repair for RAM pressure, persistent process memory growth, CPU pressure, storage problems, network issues, Windows system-file integrity, and recent critical event-log failures. Uses evidence first and protects Brahma and critical system processes.

action.description: Action: diagnose, memory_leak, repair, monitor, status, stop. diagnose collects a broad local health report; memory_leak samples process growth; repair applies only approved conservative repairs; monitor watches for persistent memory growth.

duration.description: Optional monitoring duration such as 15 seconds, 5 minutes, 24 hours, or 24h 5m.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between low-power monitor samples; default 60.

target.description: Repair target: auto, memory, system_files, disk, network, or a specific application process name/PID.

allow_disruptive.description: Permit process termination or long Windows integrity repair commands. Default false.

deep.description: Run expensive DISM/SFC integrity verification during diagnosis. Default false.

sample_seconds.description: Seconds between memory-leak samples; default 15, clamped to 5-120.

samples.description: Number of memory-leak samples; default 3, clamped to 3-8.
